svg.title: Polarized electrolytic capacitor
svg.desc: Polarized electrolytic capacitor, IEEE 315-1975 §2.2.2 polarized capacitor, style 2 (Notes 2.2A, 2.2C). Drawn exactly as C1 in the Schematex circuit exemplar (visual-eval/exemplars/circuit/ideal.svg, exemplar viewBox 512 651 72 57); one unit is one exemplar pixel. Pins: start (+) (28,9), end (−) (28,49).
